title: Figure 10. Reentry Vehicle With Surface-Integrated MHD Device and Plasma Streamlining
description: Color rendering of a conical reentry vehicle glowing red-orange as it descends through the atmosphere, with a plasma region ahead of its nose. Callout boxes read "Plasma for virtual streamlining and L/D increase," "NaK injection for ionization," and "MHD electrodes." Captioned "Figure 10. Reentry Vehicle With Surface-Integrated MHD Device and Plasma-Enabled Virtual Streamlining and L/D Increase."
